seo.title: Commerce Signal | Kain Commerce Template

faq_items.question: Does this include real payments?
answer: Not yet. The template carries payment and membership contract metadata plus handoff routes.

faq_items.question: Can this support private member content?
answer: Yes. Membership auth metadata and app-like module lanes are included in the archetype.
